entries.name: BlueCart
entries.summary: Commercial restaurant procurement platform for operators: supplier catalogs with pricing and availability, digital purchase orders, mobile receiving, and line-by-line invoice matching.

leaf_matches.reason: Official restaurant procurement page describes creating and sending digital purchase orders against supplier catalogs with live pricing and availability, receiving deliveries, and matching incoming supplier invoices to purchase orders line by line with price, quantity, or product discrepancies flagged before payment approval.

entries.name: Resy
entries.summary: Commercial restaurant reservation and guest management platform: operator reservations and experiences, bookable availability and table pacing, waitlists, card holds and deposits, and guest profiles with visit history.

leaf_matches.reason: Official operator-side /join/reservations page body describes reservations and experiences, availability planning that controls what inventory is made bookable, table pacing and table reconfiguration, walk-in and cancellation waitlists (Notify), credit card holds and deposits/prepayment, and guest profiles with notes, tags, visit history, and spend. It also states that guests can book directly through Reserve with Google and claim an available reservation. The earlier /restaurants citation is withdrawn because that URL redirects to the /join marketing page; the withdrawn snapshot is not used for this match. The page does not document an overbooking algorithm, so no such claim is made.

entries.name: GRUBBRR
entries.summary: Commercial venue-operated self-service kiosk platform for restaurants: customers browse and customize the venue menu on installed kiosks, review and confirm orders, and send them into the venue's POS and kitchen flow, with upselling, contactless payment, and loyalty/payment integrations.

leaf_matches.reason: Official self-ordering kiosk product page body states that customers customize orders and verify their choices on venue-installed self-service kiosks, choose where they want to receive the order, and that kiosk orders go straight to the kitchen. The page also describes integration with existing POS, loyalty, and payment systems, contactless payment, and automated upselling. The match is limited to this customer-composed, venue-controlled ordering and kitchen handoff; the page does not evidence separate order-progress-board or kitchen-display behavior, so those are not asserted.

entries.name: Awin
entries.summary: Commercial affiliate network with a creator/publisher-side dashboard for joining brand programs, creating trackable affiliate links, earning commissions, tracking performance, and receiving payments.

leaf_matches.reason: Official content-creator page describes creators joining brand affiliate programs, creating and sharing unique affiliate links across content formats, earning commission when a sale is generated, tracking sales and top partnerships, and receiving secure payments through the creator-facing Awin app.
